title: BundleIsArchiveWinRar
description: Transforms standard Minecraft bundles into iconic WinRAR archives.
body:
**Description**:

This resource pack transforms the standard Minecraft bundles into iconic **WinRAR archives**. It’s a perfect visual tweak for those who want to bring a bit of "desktop nostalgia" into their world.


**Key Features**:
- **New Textures**: All bundles are replaced with the classic WinRAR stack of books. 
- **Renamed Items**: Renames "Bundle" to ```bundle.zip```, "Blue Bundle" to ```blue_bundle.zip```, and so on for all colors. 
- **Language Support**: Fully compatible with **English(US)**, **Russian**, and **Ukrainian**
